premises.text: Email is a content silo where attachments get stuck and slow work
premises.evidence_span: email is a massive content silo. Stuff just gets stuck in there

premises.text: A Chrome extension connecting email and cloud services moves attachments into cloud folders while keeping email context via links
premises.evidence_span: She installs the Chrome extension, connects her email account and her favorite cloud services

premises.text: Automation rules can route incoming attachments into designated folders without manual work
premises.evidence_span: automatically send everything that she's receiving from this big enterprise company directly into the correct contract folder

premises.text: Files can be shared from the cloud with recipient-limited access controls
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless limits access to this file to just the designated recipients

premises.text: Admin policies and an event dashboard give team-wide visibility into data ownership and workflow
premises.evidence_span: gains visibility into who owns what data and what the data workflow is around her entire organization

premises.text: Cloudless is free for individuals; payment starts when governing a group's data workflow
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless is completely free for individual users. You only pay when you claim a group of people and you govern the data workflow across them

value.text: Simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud for users and IT
value.evidence_span: simple, secure workflow across the enterprise cloud that users and IT will love

causal_links.evidence_span: email is a massive content silo
data is moving seamlessly from one application to another
govern the data workflow across them

notes: Platform vision ('beginnings of a platform… any cloud service') and Outlook availability folded/excluded per v1.3.2 §4.1(4)–(5). Market-size framing excluded. Singleton D1: email-silo diagnosis is separately revisable from product.
